"""
	Transforms the provided date value based on user-selected options for 
	period and shift.
	
	Args:
	    value (Date): The date value to transform.
	    quality (Quality): The quality of the data (not used in this function).
	    timestamp (Timestamp): The timestamp of the value (not used in this function).
	
	Returns:
	    Date: The transformed date based on the selected options.
	"""
	
	def set_datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute=0, second=0):
	    """Helper function to set the date and time."""
	    date = system.date.getDate(year, month, day)
	    return system.date.setTime(date, hour, minute, second)
	"""
	# Test hour
	value = set_datetime(2024, 9, 22, 15)
	print value
	shift = "B"
	dropDownPeriod = 5  # 0: Turno A, 1: Turno B, 2: Turno C, 3: Previous Day, 4: Current Day, 5: Weeks, 6: Months, 7: Custom
	endTime = set_datetime(2020, 10, 2, 21)
	"""
	
	Year = system.date.getYear(value)
	Month = system.date.getMonth(value)
	Day = system.date.getDayOfMonth(value)
	Hour = system.date.getHour24(value)
	Min = system.date.getMinute(value)
	
	
	# Variables to hold user selections
	
	dropDownPeriod = self.getChild("root").getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("FlexContainer_dropdown").getChild("Dropdown Period").props.value
	shift = self.custom.shift
	endTime = self.getChild("root").getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("FlexContainer_dropdown").getChild("DateTimeInput_EndTime").props.value
	
	
	# Process the selected period
	if dropDownPeriod == 7:  # Custom selected
	    return endTime
	
	elif dropDownPeriod == 0:  # Selecting Shift A
	    # Siempre termina a las 05:59:59 del siguiente día
	    if shift == 'A':
	        if Hour >= 22:  # Parte inicial del turno A (22-23h)
	            value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day + 1, 5, 59, 59)
	        else:  # Parte final del turno A (00-05h)
	            value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 5, 59, 59)
	    elif shift == 'B':
	        value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 5, 59, 59)
	    elif shift == 'C':
			value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 5, 59, 59)
	
	elif dropDownPeriod == 1:  # Selecting Shift B
	    # Siempre termina a las 13:59:59 del mismo día
	    if shift == 'A':
	        if Hour >= 22:
	            value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 13, 59, 59)
	        else:
	            value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day-1, 13, 59, 59)
	    elif shift == 'B':
	        value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 13, 59, 59)
	    elif shift == 'C':
	        if Hour < 6:
	            value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day - 1, 13, 59, 59)
	        else:
	            value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 13, 59, 59)
	
	elif dropDownPeriod == 2:  # Selecting Shift C
	    # Siempre termina a las 21:59:59 del mismo día
	    if shift == 'A':
	        if Hour >= 22:
	            value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 21, 59, 59)
	        else:
	            value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day-1, 21, 59, 59)
	    elif shift == 'B':
	        value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 21, 59, 59)
	    elif shift == 'C':
	        if Hour < 6:
	            value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day - 1, 21, 59, 59)
	        else:
	            value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 21, 59, 59)
	
	elif dropDownPeriod == 3:  # Selecting Previous Day
	    # Fin de día = 05:59:59
	    if Hour < 6:  # Entre 0:00 y 5:59
	        value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day - 1, 5, 59, 59)
	    else:
	        value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 5, 59, 59)
	
	else:  # Default case, usar hora y minuto actual
	    value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, Hour, Min, 0)
		    
	return value

"""Calcular Performance global (0..1) como promedio ponderado por RunTime.
	
    Espera value["dataset"] con columnas:
    ['ID','RunStartDateTime','RunStopDateTime','RunTime','UnplannedDowntime',
     'PlannedDowntime','ScheduleTime','TotalCount','GoodCount','WasteCount',
     'Availability','Performance','Quality','OEE']
    """
    ds = value["ds"]
    if not ds or ds.getRowCount() == 0:
        return 0.0

    def f(x):
        try:
            return float(x or 0)
        except:
            return 0.0

    sum_rt = 0.0
    sum_w  = 0.0
    n = ds.getRowCount()

    for r in range(n):
        rt = f(ds.getValueAt(r, "RunTime"))
        p  = f(ds.getValueAt(r, "Performance"))  # esperado 0..1
        sum_rt += rt
        sum_w  += p * rt

    if sum_rt > 0:
        return sum_w / sum_rt

    # Fallback: promedio simple si no hay tiempo acumulado
    total_p = 0.0
    for r in range(n):
        total_p += f(ds.getValueAt(r, "Performance"))
    return (total_p / n) if n > 0 else 0.0

	if dropDownPeriod != 7:  # Assuming '7' represents a custom option
		if dropDownPeriod == 4:  # Current Day
			# Use current day's start time if after 6 AM; otherwise, use the previous day's
			newDate = set_datetime(year, month, day if hour >= 6 else day - 1, 6)
			value = newDate
	
		elif dropDownPeriod == 3:  # Previous Day
			# Use the previous day's start time based on current hour
			newDate = set_datetime(year, month, day - (1 if hour >= 6 else 2), 6)
			value = newDate
			
		elif dropDownPeriod == -1:  # No specific selection (consider using a different value)

		elif dropDownPeriod == 6:  # Months

			if dayOfWeek == 2:  # If it is Monday (Day 2)	
				if hour >= 6:

					previousMonday = system.date.addDays(system.date.getDate(year, month, day), -7)
		    
	
			elif dayOfWeek > 2:

			else:
				previousMonday = system.date.addDays(system.date.getDate(year, month, day), -6)
		
			# Set the time to 6:00:00
			value = set_datetime(system.date.getYear(previousMonday), system.date.getMonth(previousMonday), system.date.getDayOfMonth(previousMonday), 6)

try:
		"""
		Sum minutes by ReasonName for selected runs, using statereason flags:
		  - typeID = 1 -> Unplanned        -> sr.RecordDowntime = 1
		  - typeID = 0 -> Planned          -> sr.PlannedDowntime = 1
		  - typeID = 2 -> Running/Producing-> sr.RecordDowntime = 0 AND sr.PlannedDowntime = 0
	
		Inputs:
			value['selectionRun'] (list[dict]) or fallback tableInterval dataset
			value['startTime'] (datetime)  # kept for parity; not used in this exact query
			value['endTime']   (datetime)  # kept for parity; not used in this exact query
			value['typeID']    (int: 0,1,2)
	
		Returns:
			PyDataSet: [ReasonName, TotalMinutes]
		"""
		# Initialization of variables
		selectionRun = value["selectionRun"]
		startTime = value['startTime']
		endTime = value['endTime']
		tableInterval = self.view.custom.dsTableScaleInterval
	
		import system
	
		# Build RunIDs from selection or fallback dataset
		if selectionRun == []:
			selectionRun = tableInterval
			pyds = system.dataset.toPyDataSet(selectionRun)
			RunIDs = [row["RunID"] for row in pyds]
		else:
			RunIDs = [item["RunID"] for item in selectionRun]
	
		# Prepare placeholders
		if len(RunIDs) > 0:
			placeholders = ",".join(["?"] * len(RunIDs))
		else:
			return system.dataset.toDataSet(["ReasonName","TotalMinutes"], [])
	
		typeID = value['typeID']
	
		# Logic
		if typeID == 2:
			# Running / Producing: both flags = 0
			query = """
			SELECT sh.ReasonName,
			       SUM(DATEDIFF(minute, sh.StartDateTime, sh.EndDateTime)) AS TotalMinutes
			FROM statehistory sh
			INNER JOIN statereason sr ON sr.ID = sh.StateReasonID
			WHERE sh.RunID IN ({})
			  AND sr.RecordDowntime  = 0
			  AND sr.PlannedDowntime = 0
			GROUP BY sh.ReasonName;
			""".format(placeholders)
			params = RunIDs
	
		elif typeID == 1:
			# Unplanned: RecordDowntime = 1
			query = """
			SELECT sh.ReasonName,
			       SUM(DATEDIFF(minute, sh.StartDateTime, sh.EndDateTime)) AS TotalMinutes
			FROM statehistory sh
			INNER JOIN statereason sr ON sr.ID = sh.StateReasonID
			WHERE sh.RunID IN ({})
			  AND sr.RecordDowntime = 1
			GROUP BY sh.ReasonName;
			""".format(placeholders)
			params = RunIDs
	
		elif typeID == 0:
			# Planned: PlannedDowntime = 1
			query = """
			SELECT sh.ReasonName,
			       SUM(DATEDIFF(minute, sh.StartDateTime, sh.EndDateTime)) AS TotalMinutes
			FROM statehistory sh
			INNER JOIN statereason sr ON sr.ID = sh.StateReasonID
			WHERE sh.RunID IN ({})
			  AND sr.PlannedDowntime = 1
			GROUP BY sh.ReasonName;
			""".format(placeholders)
			params = RunIDs
	
		else:
			query = "SELECT 'No Data' AS ReasonName, 0 AS TotalMinutes"
			params = []
	
		# Execute
		results = system.db.runPrepQuery(query, params)
	
		# Return
		return results
	
	except:
		# Return (empty dataset on failure)
		import system
		return system.dataset.toDataSet(["ReasonName","TotalMinutes"], [])

				       SUM(DATEDIFF(minute, sh.StartDateTime, sh.EndDateTime)) AS TotalMinutes

try:
		"""
		Detail statehistory by ReasonName for selected ReasonType, classifying via statereason flags:
		  - 'No Planeado'  when RecordDowntime = 1
		  - 'Planeado'     when PlannedDowntime = 1 (and RecordDowntime != 1)
		  - 'Produciendo'  when both flags are 0
	
		Inputs:
			value['Selection'] (list[dict]): e.g., [{'Name': 'Produciendo'}]
			value['RunIDs'] (list[int]): Run IDs to filter IN (...)
	
		Returns:
			list[dict]: [{ "Name": <ReasonName>, "time": <count> }, ...]
		"""
		# Initialization of variables
		selection = value.get('Selection') or []
		run_ids = value.get('RunIDs') or []
		if not selection or not run_ids:
			return []
	
		reasonType = selection[0].get('Name')
		if reasonType is None:
			return []
	
		import system
		placeholders = ",".join(["?"] * len(run_ids))  # "?, ?, ?, ..."
	
		# Logic
		query = """
			SELECT 
				sh.ReasonName,
				COUNT(*) AS time
			FROM statehistory sh
			INNER JOIN statereason sr
				ON sr.ID = sh.StateReasonID
			WHERE sh.RunID IN ({})
			  AND CASE
					WHEN sr.RecordDowntime = 1 THEN 'No Planeado'
					WHEN sr.PlannedDowntime = 1 THEN 'Planeado'
					ELSE 'Produciendo'
				  END = ?
			GROUP BY sh.ReasonName
		""".format(placeholders)
	
		results = system.db.runPrepQuery(query, run_ids + [reasonType])
	
		# Return
		output = []
		for row in results:
			output.append({
				"Name": row["ReasonName"],
				"time": row["time"]
			})
		return output
	
	except:
		# Return (fallback safe)
		return []

		Aggregate statehistory by ReasonType using statereason flags:

		  - 'Produciendo'  when both flags are 0

try:
		"""
		Devolver eventos de statehistory solapados con un rango y recortados al rango.
	
		Color:
		  - '#6ABCE2' si ReasonCode = 1001 (prioridad máxima).
		  - '#FF8A8A' si RecordDowntime = 1 en statereason.
		  - '#FFFF8A' si PlannedDowntime = 1 (y RecordDowntime != 1).
		  - '#8AFF8A' si ambos = 0.
	
		Inputs:
			value["dbConnection"] (str)
			value["startDateTime"] (datetime)
			value["endDateTime"] (datetime)
	
		Returns:
			Dataset: [itemId, ID, startDate, endDate, label, color, opacity]
		"""
		# Initialization of variables
		db = value["dbConnection"]
		startDateTime = value["startDateTime"]
		endDateTime = value["endDateTime"]
	
		stateHistoryTable = mes_core.model.statehistoryTable(db)
	
		columns = [
			"NodeID AS itemId",
			"ID",
			# start recortado al inicio del rango
			"CASE WHEN StartDateTime < ? THEN ? ELSE StartDateTime END AS startDate",
			# end recortado al fin del rango (considerando abiertos)
			(
				"CASE WHEN COALESCE(EndDateTime, GETDATE()) > ? THEN ? "
				"ELSE COALESCE(EndDateTime, GETDATE()) END AS endDate"
			),
			"ReasonName AS label",
			# color: prioridad 1001 > RecordDowntime > PlannedDowntime > verde
			(
				"CASE "
				" WHEN ReasonCode = 1001 THEN '#6ABCE2' "
				" WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM statereason sr "
				"               WHERE sr.ID = statehistory.StateReasonID "
				"                 AND sr.RecordDowntime = 1) THEN '#FF8A8A' "
				" WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM statereason sr "
				"               WHERE sr.ID = statehistory.StateReasonID "
				"                 AND sr.PlannedDowntime = 1) THEN '#FFFF8A' "
				" ELSE '#8AFF8A' "
				"END AS color"
			),
			"0.5 AS opacity"
		]
	
		# Solape: [Start, End] con [startDateTime, endDateTime]
		where_clause = (
			"StartDateTime < ? "
			"AND COALESCE(EndDateTime, GETDATE()) > ?"
		)
	
		# Orden de parámetros:
		# 1-2: CASE startDate
		# 3-4: CASE endDate
		# 5-6: WHERE de solape
		where_args = [
			startDateTime, startDateTime,
			endDateTime,   endDateTime,
			endDateTime,   startDateTime
		]
	
		ds = stateHistoryTable.selectCustom(columns=columns, where_clause=where_clause, where_args=where_args)
		return ds
	
	except:
		import system
		return system.dataset.toDataSet(['itemId','ID','startDate','endDate','label','color','opacity'], [])
